_comment: Octail's own egg (LinuxGSM's ns2server settings were read as a reference only; pelican-eggs has no NS2 egg). App 4940 from anonymous SteamCMD, the 64-bit Linux build x64/server_linux. The install adds the libraries the server loads that the runtime image lacks into .octail-libs/ (libspeex1 from Debian 12 with apt, libtbb2 from Debian 11's archive with its SHA-256 pinned), which the start line puts on LD_LIBRARY_PATH. The start line passes name, port, map, slots, spectator slots, config, log and mod folders in the server folder (octail-config/, logs/), and the password, Workshop mods and the web admin (off by default, its own automatic port) only when set. The Steam query port (main + 1) is reserved with fixed_ports and gives the player list (A2S). The server prints no reliable start line: it counts as started once the game port (UDP) is bound, checked from 30 s on. Console input works; stop with q (as LinuxGSM does). SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times (its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration"), downloads time out and retry, and the install fails when the server binary or a library is missing.
name: Natural Selection 2
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Natural Selection 2 is a team shooter with real-time strategy by Unknown Worlds: Frontiersmen marines led by a commander fight the Kharaa aliens, who evolve and build their hive, on maps both teams fight over.
startup: octail_root="$(pwd)"; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${octail_root}/.octail-libs:${octail_root}/x64${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}"; mkdir -p octail-config/Workshop logs; octail_args=(); [ -z "${SERVER_PASSWORD}" ] || octail_args+=(-password "${SERVER_PASSWORD}"); [ -z "${MODS}" ] || octail_args+=(-mods "${MODS}"); if [ "${WEB_ADMIN}" = 1 ]; then octail_args+=(-webadmin -webdomain 0.0.0.0 -webuser admin -webpassword "${WEB_ADMIN_PASSWORD}" -webport "${WEB_ADMIN_PORT}"); fi; cd x64 && exec ./server_linux -name "{{SERVER_NAME}}" -port {{SERVER_PORT}} -map "{{MAP}}" -limit {{MAX_PLAYERS}} -speclimit {{MAX_SPECTATORS}} -config_path "${octail_root}/octail-config" -logdir "${octail_root}/logs" -modstorage "${octail_root}/octail-config/Workshop" "${octail_args[@]}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Natural Selection 2 dedicated server (Octail's own install script; LinuxGSM's ns2server settings were read as a
# reference only). App 4940, the 64-bit Linux build (x64/server_linux), anonymous SteamCMD. The server loads
# libspeex.so.1 and libtbb.so.2, which the runtime image lacks: libspeex1 comes from Debian 12 with apt (checked
# against Debian's signed archive), libtbb2 (gone since Debian 12) from Debian 11's archive with its SHA-256 pinned.
# Both are unpacked into .octail-libs/, which the start line puts on LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Failures exit non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -uo pipefail

## anonymous login: the NS2 server needs no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps # steamapps: SteamCMD's disk write error when it is missing
if ! curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz \
    https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz; then
    echo "Installation failed: SteamCMD couldn't be downloaded."
    exit 1
fi
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise, even running as root; the files are given to the server's user after the install.
chown -R root:root /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install the server with steamcmd (the Linux depot)
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
BETA=()
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || BETA=(-beta "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" "${BETA[@]}" validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 and 64 bit Steam client libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/x64/server_linux" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Natural Selection 2 dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/x64/server_linux

## Octail: the libraries the server needs besides the image's
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
chmod 755 "$TMP"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
if ! apt-get update -qq || ! (cd "$TMP" && apt-get download -qq libspeex1); then
    rm -rf "$TMP"
    echo "Installation failed: libspeex1 couldn't be downloaded from Debian."
    exit 1
fi
TBB_DEB=libtbb2_2020.3-1_amd64.deb
TBB_SHA256=87ac7778820cbd7a2c7485f7fccd2ac4437b39cbb390e49b3aeec38a826f5af9
if ! curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o "$TMP/$TBB_DEB" \
    "https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/t/tbb/$TBB_DEB"; then
    rm -rf "$TMP"
    echo "Installation failed: $TBB_DEB couldn't be downloaded from Debian."
    exit 1
fi
if ! echo "$TBB_SHA256  $TMP/$TBB_DEB" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
    rm -rf "$TMP"
    echo "Installation failed: $TBB_DEB doesn't match its SHA-256."
    exit 1
fi
rm -rf "$TMP/root" /mnt/server/.octail-libs
mkdir -p "$TMP/root" /mnt/server/.octail-libs
for DEB in "$TMP"/*.deb; do
    dpkg-deb -x "$DEB" "$TMP/root"
done
cp -a "$TMP"/root/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/. /mnt/server/.octail-libs/
rm -rf "$TMP"
for LIB in libspeex.so.1 libtbb.so.2; do
    if [ ! -e "/mnt/server/.octail-libs/$LIB" ]; then
        echo "Installation failed: $LIB is missing after unpacking the packages."
        exit 1
    fi
done

## a hint for staff: libraries the server still can't find here (the runtime image has more than this installer)
MISSING=$(cd /mnt/server/x64 && LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/mnt/server/.octail-libs:/mnt/server/x64" ldd ./server_linux 2>/dev/null | awk '/not found/ { print $1 }' | tr '\n' ' ')
[ -z "$MISSING" ] || echo "Note: not found in the installer image (the game image may have them): $MISSING"

## Octail: the server's own folders (config, logs, Workshop mods); a reinstall keeps them
mkdir -p /mnt/server/octail-config/Workshop /mnt/server/logs

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server browser (up to 64 characters, no " or \).

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on (ns2_summit, ns2_tram, ns2_veil, ns2_descent, ...). Later maps come from the map cycle in octail-config/MapCycle.json.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Players must enter it to join; empty for an open server. Letters, digits and _.@%+!- only.

variables.name: Workshop Mods
variables.description: Steam Workshop mod ids (hexadecimal, as in the mod's NS2 id), separated by spaces. The server downloads them itself at start into octail-config/Workshop.

variables.name: Web Admin
variables.description: 1 turns on the web admin page on the Web Admin Port (user admin, the password below).

variables.name: Web Admin Password
variables.description: The web admin password (user admin), 8 to 40 letters, digits or _.@%+!-. Needed when Web Admin is 1.

variables.name: Web Admin Port
variables.description: The web admin port (TCP). Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: The Steam app id of the dedicated server.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1), or start the installed files (0). Players can only join a server of their own game version.
